reviews.paraphrase: State the specific scheduling-pilot failure that would make you stop despite staff-time savings.
reviews.naturalAnswer: A missed visit that leaves a vulnerable client without essential care would stop the pilot.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the maximum number of unsafe journeys per 1,000 scheduled journeys that would stop rollout.
reviews.naturalAnswer: Three unsafe journeys out of 1,000 scheduled journeys would stop the rollout.

reviews.paraphrase: Set the minimum number of vulnerable clients out of 100 who must keep the same carer without Elena intervening before expansion.
reviews.naturalAnswer: At least 90 out of every 100 vulnerable clients must keep the same carer without Elena stepping in before expansion.

reviews.paraphrase: Choose which of three benefits repeat clients mentioned most when explaining why they hired Lumen again.
Say whether any client used the monthly product without a senior researcher and reported that its challenge changed the client's decision.
Set the minimum number of clients who must buy the new service again before half the team moves to it.
reviews.naturalAnswer: Five clients must pay for the new service again before half the team moves.

reviews.paraphrase: Decide whether the planners' roles should still change if the same planners meet the target with accurate information and fair targets.
Decide whether one plant must meet the delivery target with the same planners before all six plants receive funding.
Identify the specific human who has the final decision when an AI plan risks making a customer late.
Choose the fan group whose increased ticket buying must justify moving the GBP 18 million.
Choose whether character-first, theory-first, or neither should receive the GBP 18 million under the stated purchase conditions.
Set the required additional ticket buyers per 100 new viewers, with no fall in core-fan sales, before moving the GBP 18 million.
reviews.naturalAnswer: Ten additional new viewers out of 100 must buy a ticket, while core-fan sales remain at least level with today's campaign.

limitations: This is an adult plain-language and answerability review only.
